{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, regular fit, hip length, warm cream (#E8DCC4), soft merino wool

Straight-leg jeans, high-rise, ankle length, dark indigo (#2F3A4A), cotton denim

Single-breasted coat, relaxed fit, knee length, deep olive green (#5E6B4F), wool blend

Ankle boots, rounded toe, low block heel, chocolate brown (#5A3A29), smooth leather

Long rectangular scarf, looped snugly under the chin, rust (#A9532F), soft brushed wool

Small crossbody bag, cognac (#9A5B34), grained leather

This is a classic everyday autumn walk outfit: cozy and practical, with a coat for the cool air and boots that are comfortable for walking. The close crew neck leaves room for the scarf to sit right under your chin, as you wanted, so it frames your face. The rust of the scarf picks up the copper side of your hair, while the cream sweater echoes the lighter side, so both halves look intentional. The deep olive coat flatters your grey-green eyes, and the warm browns of the boots and bag keep the whole look harmonious with your skin tone."}
